name: opcg-arena
description: Arena deps live here, not in the vendored engine. scripts/arena.sh copies arena/ (including node_modules) into the engine, so Node resolves them from arena/node_modules — the closest node_modules to the importing file. The vendored engine's package.json is never touched. openai is present because DeepSeek is OpenAI-compatible and ships no SDK of its own; DeepSeek's own docs prescribe the OpenAI SDK with a base_url override.
